title: Data Sciences, B.S. (Information Sciences and Technology)
notes: Built from the real archived 2022-23 bulletin edition (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2022-2023/undergraduate/colleges/information-sciences-technology/data-sciences-bs/), cross-checked against its own archived Program Requirements PDF (.../data-sciences-bs.pdf), verifying the Suggested Academic Plan table's own printed semester subtotals (14/17/16/15/15/15/15/15 = Total Credits 123) against the raw HTML table cells directly (not WebFetch's summary), since 2022 is the first archive year DATSC's own suggested-plan table exists for (per the archive's own note: "the archive only contains suggested academic plans beginning with the 2018-19 edition"). Real, verified differences from DATSC-2026.json's plan, all confirmed in the raw 2022-23 HTML/PDF, not assumed: (1) STAT 184 is printed as 2 credits in this edition's own Suggested Academic Plan table (2026's file uses 3, matching the live course catalog's STAT 184 credit value, not the bulletin table's printed value -- this table-vs-catalog credit mismatch is a real, standing PSU bulletin quirk that turns out to hold in 2022 too, not something introduced later); kept the printed 2-credit value here since this file is meant to mirror that year's own printed plan. (2) The "STAT/MATH 318 or 418" pick only has 2 real alternatives this year (414 wasn't added as a third option until the 2023-24 edition) -- still resolved to MATH 318 as the single scheduled pick, for the same real reason 2026.json narrowed it (DS 320/DS 310's prereq_groups require the literal MATH-prefixed course, confirmed in the live course catalog, which is not versioned by catalog year in this app's scraper). (3) The 8-option cross-listed elective group (Semester 7/8) reads "IST 441" in this edition, not "DS 441" -- confirmed in both the archived HTML Suggested Academic Plan and the archived Program Requirements PDF, which agree with each other for 2022 (IST 441 "Information Retrieval and Organization" was renumbered to DS 441 only later; see the 2024 file's notes for exactly when). (4) Third Year sequencing differs from 2026: this edition's own table has DS 310 in Fall and STAT 380 in Spring (2026's live table has swapped them -- STAT 380 in Fall, DS 310 in Spring -- a change that first appears in the 2024-25 edition per direct comparison; see the 2024 file's notes). (5) DS 305 is scheduled (Third Year Fall, with the major's own grade-C-or-better asterisk, counted in the printed 15-credit subtotal and the 123-credit total) per the Suggested Academic Plan table, but this edition's separate Program Requirements "Prescribed Courses" enumeration table genuinely omits DS 305 from its list (verified directly in the raw PDF/HTML table cells) -- a real 2022-23 bulletin authoring inconsistency between that page's two separate tables, not a transcription error on this file's part; DS 305 became a formally enumerated prescribed course starting with the 2023-24 edition. (6) The "Application Focus Selection" match-regex options were rebuilt from this edition's own 8 focus-area course-list tables (content-matched by course-set, not by table position/order, since 2022/2023's tables carry no named headings the way 2024+ editions do) plus the archived Program Requirements PDF's Astronomy list (which includes BIOL/GEOSC 474 Astrobiology -- present in every year's PDF checked, 2022 through the live 2026 edition, but never rendered in any year's HTML course-list table, a consistent HTML-vs-PDF rendering gap, not a per-year change). This edition's own focus lists are narrower than 2026's: no DS 402 in any focus list yet (added starting 2023-24), no FIN/MGMT/MKTG/SCM 301 additions to Business Fundamentals (added starting 2024-25), no CYBER 221/451/454 or HCDD 311/331/411/412/413/IST 331/411/412/413 additions (added starting 2025-26), and Economics still includes ECON 404/406/408/421/424 (retired from the list starting 2024-25) instead of those slots simply being absent. NUTR 175 (not yet renamed NUTR 175N, which happens starting 2024-25) used as printed. (7) MATH 21 was added (Semester 3) for the same real, catalog-verified reason as 2026.json (DS 200 and STAT 184 both carry a real MATH 21 prereq in the live, non-year-versioned course catalog this app scrapes) even though, like every other year checked including the current live edition, this year's own printed Suggested Academic Plan table doesn't show MATH 21 at all -- not a 2022-specific finding, but included here since it's load-bearing for this file's own scheduling to actually reach graduation with the shared prereq data. All Program Requirements totals (General Education 45, Electives 0-9, Requirements for the Major 75-84) confirmed directly against this edition's own Program Requirements table 0. Also: this edition's own raw Suggested Academic Plan table has TWO "General Education Course" items in First Year Spring (row 4's Fall=GenEd/Spring=GenEd pairing plus row 5's Fall=PSU 17/Spring=GenEd pairing), summing to that semester's own printed 17-credit subtotal (MATH 141 4 + CMPSC 132 3 + DS 200 4 + GenEd 3 + GenEd 3 = 17) -- confirmed directly in the raw HTML table cells for this edition. DATSC-2026.json's own Semester 2 only lists ONE "GEN ED" slot (summing to 14, short of its own stated target_credits of "17") -- verified this is the same real gap in the live 2026-27 edition's own printed table, not specific to this year, so it's a pre-existing gap in the already-built 2026 file, out of scope for this file to fix. Added the second GEN ED slot here so this file's own Semester 2 matches this edition's own printed 17-credit subtotal exactly.
